a2-unit-24.24.1 Pepper is a winner:
Lucy: Pepper is a winner. By Lucy.
Lucy: Last Sunday, I was playing in a soccer game in the park with some students who go to a different college. The score was two to two, and Kate's dog Pepper was watching. Pepper and I used to practice in the park every weekend, so she knew how to play.
Lucy: Suddenly, Pepper ran onto the field and picked up the ball in her mouth. At first, I thought she was going to bring the ball to me, but then she ran to the goal and dropped the ball in. "If Pepper weren't a dog, we would count that goal!" laughed a player on the other team. Although we didn't win the game, Pepper was the hero of the day.

a2-unit-24.24.3 My dog saved my life:
Ana: My dog saved my life!
Ana: When I was a child, my family had a house at the beach in Ubatuba, and we used to go there every summer. One morning, I was walking on the beach with my dog, Mel. I threw a ball to Mel, but she didn't catch it. The ball went into a hole in the rocks. It was a cave!
Ana: When Mel and I went into the cave where the ball was, we saw some drawings on the walls. They looked very old. I wanted to stay and look at them, but Mel wasn't happy in the cave, so she pulled me out. A fisherman was walking past. "Don't go in there," he shouted. "It's too dangerous." Suddenly, some rocks fell down and closed the cave forever.
